# GET /api/v1/user/hooks/{id}

Get a specific webhook of the authenticated user

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-148`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| id | path | int64 | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

| Field | Type | Description |
